One Information Marketplace end-to-end slice delivery: a buyer publishes an ECDH recipient public key (private half stays on the buyer device); on owner approval the seller device seals the requested safe-summary slice against that key and posts a ciphertext envelope, which the buyer fetches and decrypts locally from the Received-data surface.

One Information Marketplace proactive opportunity nudges: the server derives dateless intent signals from the owner's publishable-slice metadata (and the client may post dated expiry signals), surfaced as flashcards on Agent One where the owner publishes, snoozes, or dismisses them; state is read and mutated server-side per owner.

One Information Marketplace access-request inbox: a buyer files a request for owner-approved access to a published data-slice safe projection; the owner lists, approves, or denies server-side from the marketplace surface or via Agent One over A2A.

Cross-instance one-time nonce registry for signed One voice relay tickets (migration 084). consume_relay_ticket_shared() in api/routes/one/relay_auth.py enforces single use globally via INSERT .. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; a conflicting insert means replay. Expired rows are pruned opportunistically by expiry scan. Scale-plane doctrine: Postgres now, Redis SETNX-with-TTL later behind the same seam.
RIA profile, marketplace deck actions, client relationship, invite, and share-grant services

Generalized directional trusted-connection graph. Written only via Agent One (add/remove/list intents delegated to the agent_connections lane) and via circle-invite claim (one-way claimer→inviter edge); read in-process by any backend agent (e.g. Location, Email) through TrustedConnectionsService for SOS recipient resolution and check-in targeting. People are resolved read-only through the One Location verified-recipient directory. Supersedes the former one_location_network_connections table; its forward-only removal is pending live row-count, retention, and backup preflight.

Two-way (mutual) connection graph added in migration 085. connection_requests holds the directional handshake (requester→addressee, status pending/accepted/rejected/cancelled); connections holds the accepted mutual edge canonicalized as user_a_id < user_b_id. Written only via ConnectionsService (create/accept/reject/cancel/remove), exposed under /api/one/connections/* and driven by Agent One's add-connection intent. On accept the service also mirrors two directional trusted_connections edges (source='connection') so existing Location/SOS readers keep working unchanged. People are resolved read-only through the One Location verified-recipient directory.
vault setup, unlock-status, wrapper selection, and account deletion services
